# IHG Hotels & Resorts’ Luxury & Lifestyle portfolio recognised by readers around the world


*Condé Nast Traveler's 2026 Readers' Choice Awards recognise 42 IHG Luxury & Lifestyle properties*

**LONDON, UK, 7 October 2026** – IHG Hotels & Resorts celebrates the recognition of 42 Luxury & Lifestyle properties in the[2026 Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards](https://www.cntraveler.com/inspiration/readers-choice-awards) .


IHG Hotels & Resorts is one of the world’s leading players in Luxury & Lifestyle, offering a portfolio of differentiated brands including[Six Senses](https://www.sixsenses.com/en/) ,[Regent](https://www.ihg.com/regent/hotels/gb/en/reservation) ,[InterContinental](https://www.ihg.com/intercontinental/hotels/gb/en/reservation) ,[Kimpton](https://www.ihg.com/kimptonhotels/hotels/gb/en/reservation) ,[Vignette Collection](https://www.ihg.com/vignettecollection/hotels/gb/en/reservation) and[Hotel Indigo](https://www.ihg.com/hotelindigo/hotels/gb/en/reservation) . Properties across all six brands were recognised in multiple categories and destinations worldwide, including five number one rankings.


[Six Senses Fiji](https://www.sixsenses.com/en/hotels-resorts/asia-the-pacific/fiji/fiji/) #1 Best Resort in Australasia & South Pacific (U.K. Edition)


[Six Senses Douro Valley](https://www.sixsenses.com/en/hotels-resorts/europe/portugal/douro-valley/) #1 Destination Spa in the World (U.S. Edition)


[Six Senses Zighy Bay](https://www.sixsenses.com/en/hotels-resorts/middle-east-africa/oman/zighy-bay/) #1 Resort in the Middle East (U.S. Edition)


[Six Senses Crans-Montana](https://www.sixsenses.com/en/hotels-resorts/europe/switzerland/crans-montana/) #1 Resort in Europe (U.S. Edition)


[InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort](https://www.danang.intercontinental.com/) #1 Resort in Asia (U.S. Edition)


Regarded as one of the travel industry's longest-running and most influential reader-voted awards programmes, the annual rankings reflect the experiences and preferences of global travellers, recognising the hotels, resorts and destinations that continue to resonate most strongly with guests and readers.

Spanning more than 70 countries, IHG’s Luxury & Lifestyle portfolio is intentionally differentiated, designed to meet evolving definitions of modern luxury across occasions - from ultra-bespoke, rarefied experiences to culturally connected, experience-led travel.


For the full list of winners, please visit here for the[U.S. edition](https://www.cntraveler.com/inspiration/readers-choice-awards) and here for the[U.K. edition](https://www.cntraveller.com/article/readers-choice-winners-2026) .

## About IHG®


[IHG Hotels & Resorts](https://www.ihgplc.com/) (tickers: LON:IHG for Ordinary Shares; NYSE:IHG for ADRs) is a global hospitality company, with a purpose to provide True Hospitality for Good.


With a family of 21 hotel brands and[IHG One Rewards](https://www.ihg.com/onerewards/content/us/en/home) , one of the world's largest hotel loyalty programmes with over 160 million members, IHG has more than one million rooms across 7,100 hotels in over 100 countries, and a development pipeline of a further 2,400 properties.
